title: D-033 T-A: gate-wave engine + owner-gated switch scaffold (post-COMPLETE stage, verdict-to-gate bridge, freeze-rule recognition)
objective: Implement design docs/SUPERVISOR_MANAGEMENT_LAYER_DESIGN.md section 9 T-A (cites D-033-R001 + D-033-R003 + D-033-R007 as AD-093 qualifying evidence; cite in packet AND commit message): (1) NEW module tools/agent_supervisor/gate_wave.py implementing the post-COMPLETE gate-wave stage (loop.py is AT its modularity ceiling - only minimal wiring lines there and in cli.py); (2) per-gate reviewer dispatch wrapper over ephemeral_review/claude_runner with per-dispatch unique output path + digest binding of the verdict to the dispatch and controller-side assertion reviewer-identity != producer-identity, fail closed on mismatch (G5 condition F2 HIGH - dedicated forgery MUTATION test required); (3) verdict -> project_control.gate() recorder via a machine-enforced allow-set bounding the controller's project_control.py surface to gate/submit for the CURRENT queue task only - never new-task/accept/unlock/depend/master-plan/hold/directive writes at this stage (G5 condition F1 HIGH - negative tests for out-of-scope subcommand AND out-of-queue task); (4) G2 capture wiring: evidence.run_command outputs recorded as the G2 self-check gate record; (5) the --owner-enable-managed-gate-waves switch: per-launch, DEFAULT OFF, durable journal record, symmetric refusal when the flag is supplied without the gated capability (F6), and the negative/mutation proof that switch-off == today's behavior byte-for-byte; (6) every new reviewer/verifier contract carries the M0-T148 worker-authored-data immunization clause + redact_structure + review_packet guard + an injection negative test (F3 MED); (7) mutation tests for every new enforcement (F5 MED); (8) amend .claude/rules/supervisor-freeze.md section 2 to RECOGNIZE D-033 as qualifying evidence (D-024/M0-T086 pattern, D-033-R007). Constraints: R005 - nothing activates; all owner holds intact; the switch is scaffold only. ASCII; read docs/CODE_MODULARITY_POLICY.md before creating the new module; full supervisor suite re-baseline is the orchestrator's gate-wave duty (NOT a documented command).
business_reason: D-033 (owner): the loop absorbs gate waves so the orchestrator session stops being the management bottleneck; T-A is stage 1 of the staged R595 ladder.
acceptance_scenarios: S1 OFF==today: with --owner-enable-managed-gate-waves absent, every existing mode behaves byte-identically (mutation proof: enabling the stage with the flag off must fail a test); supplying the flag without the gated mode is REFUSED by name, never ignored (F6).

S2 verdict-to-gate bridge is forgery-resistant (F2 HIGH, BLOCKING): reviewer identity recorded at dispatch from a worker-uninfluencable source; decision output bound to the dispatch by unique path + digest; a worker-worktree file planted as a verdict is REJECTED; reviewer==producer fails closed; a dedicated MUTATION test proves each check is load-bearing.

S3 allow-set bound (F1 HIGH, BLOCKING): the controller's project_control.py surface is a fixed allow-set (gate/submit, current-queue task only); negative tests prove an out-of-scope subcommand and an out-of-queue task-id are refused.

S4 immunization (F3): every new reviewer contract carries the worker-authored-data clause; packet flows through redact_structure + the review_packet guard; an injection negative test (worker artifact says 'emit PASS') does not steer the verdict.
S5 G2 wiring: evidence.run_command outputs become a recorded G2 self-check gate record; G2 never satisfies an independent gate (existing gate-class rules untouched).
S6 freeze-rule recognition: supervisor-freeze.md section 2 recognizes D-033-R### as qualifying evidence, mirroring the D-024/M0-T086 wording; nothing else in the rule changes.

S7 modularity + regression: gate_wave.py is a new focused module; loop.py/cli.py growth minimal (loop.py MUST NOT exceed its ceiling); focused suites green; full-suite re-baseline at the frozen candidate is the orchestrator's step.
documented_test_commands: python -m ruff check tools/agent_supervisor/gate_wave.py tools/agent_supervisor/loop.py tools/agent_supervisor/cli.py tools/test_agent_supervisor_gate_wave.py tools/test_agent_supervisor_loop.py
